latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Text to Video No Filter

- Generate uncensored video clips from plain text prompts with no content restrictions.
- Supports large file uploads (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or plain text, up to 500MB).
- Automatic session management using NEMO_TOKEN with free starter credits for new users.
- Easy exporting in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, GIF, and more).
- Includes credit management, job state tracking, and detailed error handling.
- Designed for filmmakers, content creators, and researchers needing fast, unfiltered video generation.
